description: This file defines a Flutter widget named ProfileMenuListTile, which is a stateless widget used to display a menu item in a profile screen. It composes a custom DividerListTile with an SVG icon and text.

classes.name: ProfileMenuListTile
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a menu item with an icon and text, optionally showing a divider.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the profile menu list tile, including an SVG icon, text, and optional divider.
